speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Pancoast Tumor (Superior Sulcus Tumor)

The CT Chest confirms a solid mass at the apex of the right lung, and your neurological exam showing 2/5 strength with decreased sensation is classic for a Pancoast tumor compressing the lower trunk of the brachial plexus. Your history of smoking and weight loss further supports this malignant process. I must clarify that Multiple Sclerosis is incorrect for this presentation, as it does not cause a localized lung mass or this specific pattern of arm weakness.
